{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The sound principle of judicial review has turned into an intolerable presumption of judicial supremacy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A Republican Congress, working with a Republican president, will restore the separation of powers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A Republican Congress, working with a Republican president, will re-establish a government of law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Using Article III of the Constitution to limit federal court jurisdiction is a way to achieve the goal of restoring the separation of powers and re-establishing a government of law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Limiting federal court jurisdiction can be used in instances where judges are banning the use of \"under God\" in the Pledge of Allegiance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Limiting federal court jurisdiction can be used in instances where judges are prohibiting depictions of the Ten Commandments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Limiting federal court jurisdiction can be used in potential actions invalidating the Defense of Marriage Act (DOMA).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Judicial activists are imposing unwarranted and unconstitutional restrictions on the free exercise of religion in the public square.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An estimated 38 million people worldwide are living with HIV/AIDS.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"More than 20 million people have died as a result of HIV/AIDS.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"HIV/AIDS has created an estimated 14 million HIV/AIDS orphans – children who have lost at least one parent to HIV/AIDS.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Nearly one million Americans are believed to be infected with HIV.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
